entities.name: Michel Écochard
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Michel Écochard was a French architect and urban planner. He played a large part in the urban planning of Casablanca from 1946 to 1952 during the French Protectorate, then in the French redevelopment of Damascus during its occupation of Syria. He was also trained as an archeologist.
